text:
```yaml
name: Check Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

jobs:
  check-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@6e8b0c3c1b1e5f5a2d3f4e5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - name: Install just
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y just

      - name: Run release check
        run: |
          just check-release
```
